A Ph.D. Degree is required. Candidates must have total service experience of at least 15 years of Teaching, Research, or Administration in University, Colleges, and other institutions of Higher Education as a Professor or Associate Professor. | Applicants need a minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based on performance based Appraisal (PBAS) as per UGC regulation in Appendix I for direct recruitment of Principals in Colleges. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent through proper channel to the following postal address: Office of the Principal i/C, Hojai Girls' College, Hojai Assam, Pin: 782415

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Master Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent in the point of scale where grading system is followed) from a recognized University. A Ph.D. Degree is required. Candidates must have total service experience of at least 15 years of Teaching, Research, or Administration in University, Colleges, and other institutions of Higher Education as a Professor or Associate Professor. Applicants need a minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based on performance based Appraisal (PBAS) as per UGC regulation in Appendix I for direct recruitment of Principals in Colleges. A minimum of 10 research publications in Peer Reviewed or UGC listed Journals and a minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix III at table-2 as per UGC Regulation 2018 are mandatory. Relaxation of 5% may be provided at Master Degree Level for SC, ST, and Differently abled (Physically and Visually differently able) candidates based on qualifying marks without including any grace marks.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves reviewing applications submitted in DHE's Format along with bio-data, self-attested testimonials, and the required demand draft, followed by an interview for eligible candidates.

rows.details: Visit the Hojai Girls' College portal

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for HGC Principal?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the post of Principal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 October 2026, which is within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for HGC Principal?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master Degree with at least 55% marks, a Ph.D. Degree, 15 years of service experience, required API score, 10 research publications, and a minimum 110 research score.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for HGC Principal?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years as per prescribed rule.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for HGC Principal?
faq.answer: Applicants must pay an application fee of Rs. 5,000/- via demand draft in favour of Principal I/C, Hojai Girls' College, Hojai, payable at State Bank of India, Hojai Branch.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for HGC Principal recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply offline using DHE's Format along with a bio-data, self-attested testimonials, and a demand draft, sending it through proper channel to the Office of the Principal i/C, Hojai Girls' College, Hojai Assam, Pin: 782415.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks?
faq.answer: Relaxation of 5% at the Master Degree level is provided for SC, ST, and Differently abled (Physically and Visually differently able) candidates based on qualifying marks without including grace marks.
